results.rationale: Procedural/evaluation rule acknowledged—will be complied with in the submission to avoid disqualification.

Experience evidence shows at least two completed Solar Energy projects (CAP-008, CAP-044, also CAP-032) meeting the required domain and count, with contract values indicated (subject to matching the RFP table M1 thresholds).
ISO 9001 is explicitly listed as a certification held in the company profile, satisfying the mandatory ISO 9001 requirement.
Prior work for Federal/Provincial Government clients is evidenced by capability records and is consistent with the profile’s client footprint.
Bid security submission is a procedural compliance item and the profile indicates we can arrange a scheduled-bank guarantee/CDR up to the facility limit.
We can provide a PMP-certified project manager (profile and PMP-tagged projects support this), but the required minimum 8 years of infrastructure project experience is not explicitly evidenced.
Company profile confirms FBR National Tax Number with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status, satisfying the FBR/active taxpayer registration requirement.

This is a delivery/spec compliance obligation and our prior Solar Energy deployments make the commitment to supply Tier-1 modules with the stated efficiency and warranty credible, though the exact 21%/25-year figures are not evidenced in summaries.
